functions.name: TICKER
functions.description: Shariah compliance data for an exchange-suffixed ticker (ASML, ASML.AS). Fields default to Result; use MX.FIELDS() to list them.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Field name(s): "Result", "AAOIFI", "Purification"… or a range of names

functions.name: ISIN
functions.description: Shariah compliance data for an ISIN. An ISIN listed on several exchanges returns one row per listing — add "ticker" or "Market" to the fields to tell them apart. Fields default to Result.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Field name(s) or a range of names

functions.name: FIELDS
functions.description: Lists every field name for MX.TICKER and MX.ISIN with its type, tier (basic/full) and whether your plan includes it.
